audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Sett all seven stages while whys[6] on the same page said '2+ items flips to Cho'Gath'. The already-audited mirror set Level 6 to Skill and 2+ items to Cho'Gath.
audit.why: Feast is 80s of true damage scaled to health, so Level 6 is not a free Sett win, and Feast stacks plus tank items genuinely outsize him late. The mirror's shape — five Sett stages, Skill at 6, Cho'Gath at two items — is what both pages' prose argues for.
audit.corrected: win[4]/phases[4].side to Skill and win[6]/phases[6].side to Cho'Gath as one atomic paired group, ratings inverted from the mirror's (Level 6 5/10, 2+ items 4/10 from Sett's side), with whys[4], phases[4].why, phases[6].why, spikes[1] and mid rewritten so the prose stops promising a clean level-6 kill.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Rupture (Knockup)' is not an ability name, and it was the tracked cooldown in the TL;DR, win condition, loading screen, focus panel, cooldown panel, three phases, the do's and five report sections. The cooldown panel even listed it twice — once under the invented name and once under the real one.
audit.why: The ability is Rupture: a 950-range delayed knockup and slow on a flat 6s cooldown — far too short to build a matchup around. The cooldown that actually decides this lane is Feral Scream at 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, because a silence stops Haymaker mid-combo. Vorpal Spikes is 8/7/6/5/4s and Feast 80/70/60s.
audit.corrected: The invented name removed everywhere and the tracked cooldown retargeted from Rupture to Feral Scream at 11s, with Rupture restated at its real 6s and 950 range as a telegraph to sidestep.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said twice that The Show Stopper 'suppress-slams' him, and it never explained the two interactions that actually decide the lane: Feral Scream's silence locking out Haymaker, and Feast being true damage on a health scale.
audit.why: Riot's text for The Show Stopper is carry, slam, damage and a landing slow — no suppression. Feral Scream is a 300-range cone silence, so the counterplay is trading outside 300 rather than 'dodging his W'. Feast ignores resistances and scales with health, which makes Sett's HP-and-Grit build the wrong answer to it — the counter is denying the stacks.
audit.corrected: Suppression removed from spikes[1] and mid; the silence-locks-Haymaker rule stated in dontsFull[1].d, the cooldown panel, winCon, report[1] and report[5]; Feast's true damage vs HP stacking stated in dontsFull[2].d and phases[6].why.

notes: Two things were being taught wrong. The page tracked an invented ability, 'Rupture (Knockup)', in twelve places — and even the real Rupture is a flat 6s cooldown, far too short to plan around; the cooldown that decides this lane is Feral Scream, because a silence takes Haymaker out of your hands mid-combo. The page also promised a clean level-6 kill off a 'suppress-slam' The Show Stopper does not have, against a champion whose ultimate is 80s of true damage on a health scale — exactly the damage type Sett's HP-and-Grit build cannot mitigate.
